section.sectionSummaryBrief: This drawing down is now achieved through the service of the three things, but presently it is in concealment, and in the future it will be revealed through Moshiach, connecting above and below.
section.t: And this drawing down is through the service of the three things now.
However, now it is in concealment,
and in the future it will be in revelation,
that in Moshiach there will be the connection of above and below,
and through him this will also be drawn down throughout the entire world,
that the earth will be filled with knowledge of Havayah64,
will be filled with knowledge of Havayah
with the coming of Moshiach Tzidkeinu, speedily and truly.
